mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom steel building and a standard prefab kit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom steel buildings offer complete design flexibility and structural durability tailored to your site and purpose. Unlike off-the-shelf prefabricated kits sold in fixed dimensions, custom steel structures are engineered around your specific layout, door placements, ceiling heights, and local wind or snow load demands. A practical tradeoff is that fully custom engineering requires upfront design coordination, but it prevents the costly field modifications often required when forcing a stock kit to suit specialized workshop, commercial, or storage needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom steel buildings are engineered to your exact dimensions, site conditions, and door openings, whereas prefab kits use fixed dimensions that often require modifications.
